brief: A storage box whose lid is held shut with magnets.

requirements.evidence: Full hex base piece:0,0,0;full with full-depth bin bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full (hex-bin-full) inside it, forming the storage volume; staged with a heap of M3 screws and a roll of electrical tape inside.
Solid full top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top (hex-main-cover-solid) fitted over the bin on cover snaps.

setCoverMagnets on:true was dropped as ALREADY_FITTED, confirming the cover is magnet-fitted by default; BOM lists stock Neodymium disc magnets Ø5×1 mm ×6 and Steel BBs 4.5 mm ×6 as the magnet/BB pair that holds the lid shut.

finish.summary: Built a single-cell hexagonal storage box: a full hex base with a full-depth storage bin, closed by a solid full top cover (lid). The cover is magnet-fitted — enabling magnets reported ALREADY_FITTED — and the BOM includes 6× Ø5×1 mm neodymium disc magnets with 6× matching steel BBs that hold the lid shut. Open faces were capped and joints locked per house rules; the bin is staged with M3 screws and electrical tape (the screws sit below the rim inside the closed bin, as expected). check_build is ok with meshClash clear.

events.text: Building you a magnet-lidded storage box — first mapping bases, bins and covers to find a lid that takes magnets.
